journey.name: signin with second link
journey.description: Verifies that a payment link opened while a sign-in link is pending does not drop the sign-in: the authorization sheet opens first, and the payment opens once the sheet closes. Covers a payment link opened on the PIN screen in both orders, and one opened while the authorization sheet is open. Precondition: an onboarded wallet with savings funded, the PIN on, Paykit enabled and a Pubky profile created in Bitkit. Adapted from Android: the sign-in link is bitkit://pubky-auth/signin, opened with xcrun simctl openurl using the test simulator UDID.

actions.action: Run xcrun simctl terminate <UDID> to.bitkit

Run xcrun simctl openurl <UDID> "bitkit://pubky-auth/signin?caps=/pub/locks.app/:rw&relay=https%3A%2F%2Fhttprelay.pubky.app%2Finbox%2F&secret=e3t7e3t7e3t7e3t7e3t7e3t7e3t7e3t7e3t7e3t7e3s&cid=locks.test&cpk=5jsjx1o6fzu6aeeo697r3i5rx15zq41kikcye8wtwdqm4nb4tryo"
If the simulator asks to open the link in Bitkit, tap Open
Verify the PIN screen is visible
Run xcrun simctl openurl <UDID> "bitcoin:bcrt1qw508d6qejxtdg4y5r3zarvary0c5xw7kygt080?amount=0.0001"
Enter the PIN with the number pad keys
Verify the authorize button (id "PubkyAuthAuthorize") is visible and no Send screen is shown
Tap Cancel (id "PubkyAuthCancel")
Verify the Send flow opens for 10 000 sats, then close it until the wallet home screen is visible
